title: When THE TRANSMITTER meets THE RITUALIST:

dialogue.speaker: THE TRANSMITTER
dialogue.text: Before the telegraph, information moved at the speed of a horse. Now, it moves at the speed of light. We can send the price of pork from Chicago to New York in seconds. We can control markets. We can unite the nation. Communication is transportation without the body.

dialogue.speaker: THE RITUALIST
dialogue.text: You think the miracle is getting the message there. I think the miracle is that we share the message at all.

dialogue.speaker: THE STREETS
dialogue.text: The Transmitter looks at the telegraph machine.
